nodes.title: 14.4.3, QA on ac4e8e88, three of four findings. (1) 905a3e50 / b28d919f: after "ek example se samjhao" she gave a park of her own, 6 m by 4 m, and then "Total kitna?". The example request’s shapes said "your own numbers", and fe59b5f1’s worked-shape wording alone did not stop invented numbers. An example asked for now carries the kit’s worked example: a reteach that does not advance the teach step (owner-4 contract kept), whole, marked shown (move.stuck). Before the teaching starts it routes to the same plan. brain/say.js adds guard "invented" on worked moves and on shown reteaches: a number that is not the kit example’s is flagged, unless it is a unit scaling (× or ÷ 10/100/1000) or arithmetic on two different numbers of 3 or more, with 0-2 free and 3D / ordinals skipped. It gets a rewrite, then its sentences are dropped. Replay across 830 kits with a worked example: the example request carries the kit example 0/830 before, 830/830 after. TEST, read-only: 5 of 324 worked_example lines flagged, 4 of them real invented numbers. QA’s 6 m / 4 m line is caught. (2) 6f1323e8: a right 160 got "160 ko ek baar dobara check kijiye". Doubt on a right answer (check it again, are you sure, pakka?) is now a deny, and selfPosedVerdict reads "160?" as an answer. TEST: 0 of 1276 teacher lines after a correct answer hit, before and after. (4) f76aacd1: the switch offer named a "Geometry button". The shape now names the topic found for what they asked, and the button by its exact label. Finding 3 ("160?" praised, then a new item) waits on the trace. Tests: tests/r1443-qa-ac4e8e88.test.mjs (6, fail on 12c0e480).
